provenance: Manually curated seed of widely known npm and PyPI package names. Names were selected as recognizable reference points for edit-distance comparison. This is not a live top-N download list, is not ordered by popularity, and contains no download counts.
notTopNDisclaimer: This dataset must not be presented as a live download ranking or as authoritative popularity data.
updateInstructions: Verify each candidate name against the official registry, edit this file, bump datasetVersion and updatedAt, and run go test ./internal/engine/.
